input: Draft a personal mission statement this weekend

gold.taskTitle: Draft a personal mission statement this weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to write a personal mission statement over the coming weekend.

questions.title: What life areas should the statement cover?
questions.description: Identify whether the mission statement is focused on career, personal values, family, all of the above, or something else.

questions.title: Have you attempted a mission statement before?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is starting from scratch or refining a previous attempt.

questions.title: What is prompting you to write this now?
questions.description: Understand the specific trigger or life moment driving this task, such as a career change, milestone birthday, or feeling directionless.

questions.title: How long should the final statement be?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single sentence, a short paragraph, or a longer structured document.

questions.title: Which day and time block are you setting aside?
questions.description: Pin down whether this is Saturday morning, Sunday afternoon, or spread across both days, to help structure the plan.

questions.title: Do you want a guided framework or free writing?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a structured method such as Stephen Covey or Oprah's approach versus open-ended reflection.

questions.title: Who, if anyone, will read or review this?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is purely private, to be shared with a mentor, coach, or included in something like a LinkedIn profile or resume.
